context_requirements: Expression of glutathione transferases (especially GSTP1) or GCLM, the annotated target
Intact oxidative stress response (KEAP1-NFE2L2) for transcriptional feedback
Functional p53 for apoptotic and cell-cycle transcriptional responses
Low baseline antioxidant capacity so that GST inhibition causes redox imbalance
falsifiers: No change in NFE2L2 target genes (HMOX1, TXNRD1, GCLM, SQSTM1) at 6 or 24 h in any line
No induction of p53 targets (CDKN1A, GADD45A, PMAIP1) at 24 h in TP53-wild-type lines
No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h
Strong and uniform transcriptional response across all nine lines, including lines with low GST expression
No evidence of apoptosis or oxidative stress programs at 24 h

evidence.supports: GSTP1 inhibitor NBDHEX induces apoptosis and p53 phosphorylation in A375 melanoma cells
Glutathione transferase degraders induce apoptosis in cancer cells

changes: Removed NFE2L2 from proximal_down because it is listed as both up and down at the same time; NFE2L2 is expected to be activated (up) by oxidative stress after GST inhibition.

Removed KEAP1 from proximal_down because KEAP1 is not a GST gene and its transcription is not expected to decrease; KEAP1 is a negative regulator of NFE2L2 and is not a direct transcriptional target of GST inhibition.
Kept GSTM2 and GSTZ1 in proximal_down as GST family members whose expression may be reduced by inhibitor-mediated feedback or degradation.
Kept CBR1 and CBR3 in proximal_down as they are related to carbonyl reduction and may be co-regulated with GSTs, but noted this is less certain.
Kept JUN, FOS, GADD45B, ATF1, NFE2L2, HMOX1, TXNRD1, SQSTM1 in proximal_up as oxidative stress and AP-1/NRF2 target genes consistent with GST inhibition.
Kept late_up genes as p53-dependent apoptotic and stress response genes consistent with delayed response.
Kept late_down genes as proliferation and cell-cycle genes consistent with growth arrest.
Kept generic_effects as they describe broad programs rather than specific genes.
Kept kinetics as slow because transcriptional responses to GST inhibition and oxidative stress are expected to develop over hours.
Kept magnitude as weak at 6h and moderate at 24h, consistent with slow kinetics.
Kept line_response as moderate for most lines and weak for HA1E, MCF7, VCAP based on known differences in GST expression, p53 status, and antioxidant capacity.
Kept context_requirements as they are plausible biological prerequisites.
Kept falsifiers as they are appropriate tests of the hypothesis.
Kept evidence citations because both abstracts support the stated claims about apoptosis induction by GST inhibitors.
